storm.measures: per round: junk_share = share of won parts that went to junk or polished-junk bidders (storm sybils included); junk_paid_fusd and storm_paid_fusd = pay of passed parts won by them; storm_earned_fusd = fUSD on all storm accounts (and their earlier accounts) at round end, read on-chain; key_held_fusd = fUSD a current storm account holds beyond the paid_value the factory recorded for it from settled jobs (job pay sits in job accounts until the check passes and the job settles, so this should be 0)
